verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the public stackblitz/bolt.new GitHub repository, which implies the core product's source is available, but the cited excerpts describe only in-browser features and never mention running or deploying it yourself. All other docs describe Bolt as a hosted SaaS with bolt.host hosting, token billing and cloud services. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting or local-install instructions, a stated license or open-source status, parity between self-hosted and hosted versions, and hands-on reports of self-hosting.
